name: Constant (development)
description: A constant signal checks a flat fitted frame and its retained time residue.

name: Ramp (development)
description: A fixed rise checks prospective continuation.

name: Unequal intervals (development)
description: Unequal source times require an exact fractional prediction.

name: A constant below zero
description: Repeated negative observations do not imply an unknown value.

name: A ramp with unequal intervals
description: Actual elapsed source time matters more than the number of arrivals.

name: The trend reverses
description: The rising line must face a later fall before the next fit can change.

name: The signal alternates
description: Extending the latest direction can be worse than holding the last value.

name: A sudden step
description: A flat period changes level, then becomes flat again.

name: Missing samples across a change
description: Unknown targets stay unassessed while the latest available line ages.

name: Missing observations at the start
description: One known sample enables hold-last before two samples enable a fitted line.

name: Observations stop arriving
description: Predictions continue, but no later values exist to validate them.

name: No measured values
description: A stream of open observations supplies no numeric training evidence.
